name: ACS shared ops SQLite (bi-temporal)
purpose: ONE versionable shared ops.sqlite for transcript rows, three JEV gate kinds, issue/claim snapshots, and embeds. Partitioned table namespaces. Bi-temporal valid_time + recorded_at; default read = most-recent backward (as-of).
summary: Shared ops.sqlite module. Namespaces: transcript_*, gate_*, claim_*, embed_*. Bi-temporal. Langfuse via OTLP only (session-ops). Embeds batched offline — never on JEV hot path. Part of HOTLOAD full.
